title: C271: qualify isolated missing source import-digest refusal
body:
<!-- c271-p18-delivery:start -->
## Latest status: P18 libc metadata implementation verified; partial handoff saved

C271 remains open and blocked on actual-host, full-routine and integration gates. P18 implements the already adopted P16/P17 policies that address the libc metadata predicates encountered during static host preparation. Its accepted scope is bounded metadata behavior; it does not establish successful loading or host qualification.

### Change and verification

The explicit 0.1.2 PLT and 0.1.3 PLT/static-TLS plan/profile pairs are separate. Only the actual selected Python libc dependency, bound to the unchanged fixed libc and loader pins, can receive the private parser policy. It admits exactly the three adopted processor tags as opaque metadata. Only 0.1.3 adds exact DT_FLAGS=24; P16's original refusal remains intact. Earlier parsers, pins, limits, fixtures, expected results and consumers are unchanged. Each full recheck reconstructs the binding proof.

The independent guarded run passed **412 selected methods**: 73 P16, 41 P17, 135 inspection, 40 mapping, 96 origin and 27 provider/driver compatibility. There were zero failures, errors, skips, forbidden actual process attempts or source changes. A separate audit matched all 114 new observations to the frozen inputs and literal expectations. Independent source/adapter and documentary reviews found no mandatory findings.

Runs used CPython3.12.14 on Linux x86_64/glibc2.41 and exact frozen working bytes, subsequently bound to [technical commit 5b4d6aa4](https://github.com/Omegapy/OntoKin/commit/5b4d6aa459203c5700c71444f6cd9d662e783a83). They are not clean-main or CI results. Workflow, documentation and whitespace checks passed on published records. Complete evidence: [review](https://github.com/Omegapy/OntoKin/blob/5b4d6aa459203c5700c71444f6cd9d662e783a83/docs/engineering/localized-repair-c271/libc-implementation-p18/review/REPORT.md) and [outcome](https://github.com/Omegapy/OntoKin/blob/5b4d6aa459203c5700c71444f6cd9d662e783a83/docs/engineering/localized-repair-c271/libc-implementation-p18/PHASE-OUTCOME.json).

### Delivery and retained state

The final independently reviewed [P18 handoff ZIP](https://chatgpt.com/library?file_id=libfile_fde3_f-afd0158605648191a414c3c1d8c33860_2ab2a24d43748191957f9bcc356b59de&account_id=personal) and its byte-identical [Continue prompt](https://chatgpt.com/library?file_id=libfile_fde3_f-b0092dc6408081919e9a8e4df2388aa4_2ab2a24d43748191957f9bcc356b59de&account_id=personal) and [Recover prompt](https://chatgpt.com/library?file_id=libfile_fde3_f-00f7cfcbdb4c8191bee5259493cae9b1_2ab2a24d43748191957f9bcc356b59de&account_id=personal) are saved and verified by actual readback. [Separate Git receipt](https://github.com/Omegapy/OntoKin/blob/2f791017c6559bfd47937b32b1862cfe98a81551/docs/engineering/localized-repair-c271/libc-implementation-p18/P18-DELIVERY.json), [saved delivery receipt](https://chatgpt.com/library?file_id=libfile_fde3_f-1c84c026826081919d90441cb4b88e8b_2ab2a24d43748191957f9bcc356b59de&account_id=personal) and [terminal audit](https://chatgpt.com/library?file_id=libfile_fde3_f-93610f4d9294819197fdc63c60cb8bb5_2ab2a24d43748191957f9bcc356b59de&account_id=personal) bind the exact archive, publication and checks. Terminal confirmation supersedes only matching P18 source-time pending fields. This bounded phase and its partial delivery are complete; the parent remains open.

The retained branch is `work/c271-missing-import-digest-control`, at `2f791017c6559bfd47937b32b1862cfe98a81551`. Main is `70ca7e68ff95df876f801137369d176fe5b2bab3`. PR274 stays draft/open/unmerged and issue273 stays open. No main lease, merge or branch deletion occurred. R01/R02 are done; R03–R05 remain not_done; P01 is done and P02 remains in_progress.

No actual-host admission, H0/H1, target process, installation, Node/ldd, native/model/hosted execution or original-seven/full routine ran. N57 remains external, never a runtime pass or skip. The real-child driver method and unrelated installer/broad local-check cohorts were not selected. Prior failures and historical unknown operations remain preserved.

First remaining action, in a fresh chat: reconcile this delivery and live GitHub, then declare a bounded actual-input/operational-plan review for H0. Stop at a new concrete blocker or the H0 boundary; H1 and the complete routine need later gates. Main-only licensing PR275 must be reconciled when integration is selected. No second phase was started here.

### Full previous description

The previous description approached the GitHub body limit. Its complete exact text and hash are preserved at [the verbatim previous issue description](https://github.com/Omegapy/OntoKin/blob/5b4d6aa459203c5700c71444f6cd9d662e783a83/docs/engineering/localized-repair-c271/libc-implementation-p18/history/ISSUE273-BODY-BEFORE-P18.json). The other discussion, commits and phase evidence remain available. Condensing this current status does not delete or supersede prior evidence.
